jobs.title: AI Trainer Image QA Evaluator
jobs.description: Location: South Korea | Remote Engagement: Freelance / Independent Contractor | Project-Based | Part-Time About the Project We are looking for English-speaking Image Quality Evaluators based in South Korea to support AI training and evaluation projects. You will review images and assess their quality according to project guidelines, helping improve the accuracy and performance of AI systems. You do not need to be Korean. We welcome applicants of any nationality who are currently living in South Korea, have lived there for several years, and are highly familiar with Korean culture, everyday life, and local context. What You'll Do Evaluate images based on quality standards and project guidelines. Identify issues such as blur, poor lighting, noise, exposure, compression, and framing. Evaluate visual content with awareness of South Korean cultural and local context . Accurately describe and interpret images in English. Maintain high accuracy, consistency, and productivity. Flag unusual cases or data-quality issues to the project team. Requirements Currently residing in South Korea. Legally authorized to work as an independent contractor in South Korea. Have a South Korean bank account in your own name to receive payments. Have lived in South Korea for several years and have strong familiarity with Korean culture and local context. English: C1 level or above. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed guidelines. Laptop/desktop and reliable internet connection. Previous experience in AI, data annotation, transcription, QA, or content evaluation is a plus, but not required . Nationality is not a requirement. Local knowledge and lived experience in South Korea are. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description: DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be! The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market. This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
